title: Deployment Health
subtitle: Runtime checks for the services that affect hosted and self-hosted reliability.
byokStable: A stable server key is configured.
byokEphemeral: Ephemeral keys are allowed; configure a stable key before production.
byokMissing: No stable BYOK key is configured.
storesShared: The rate-limit store uses shared storage.
storesMemory: One or more memory stores are in use; this is only suitable for local or single-instance deployments.
storesMissingHosted: Hosted mode needs a shared rate-limit store.
defaultModelReady: A usable model source is available.
defaultModelMissing: No server or local model source is configured.
searchReady: Search is available through server defaults or local settings.
ragReady: PDF parsing, indexing, and knowledge retrieval are available.
ragPartial: Knowledge retrieval is available, but PDF parsing is unavailable.
ragUnavailable: Knowledge services are configured, but indexing or retrieval is unavailable.
voiceReady: Speech services are available through server defaults or local settings.
